extraction_notes: Extracted SI Tables S3 and S5 for catalyst-performance entries using the paper catalyst names provided. SI Table S4 is a literature-comparison table and was excluded. SI Tables S6 and S7 report additional treated variants (In2O3-CNT-S1, In2O3-CNT-S2, In2O3-CNT-HT) not included in the provided catalyst-name list; duplicate In2O3-CNT rows in S5-S7 were not repeated. Characterization-only figures/tables were excluded. Figure S16 contains plotted water co-feed performance but no reaction conditions are stated in the SI caption/text provided, so no approximate plot records were extracted.
